title: Khuphela Iividiyo ze-TikTok Ngaphandle kwe-Watermark (Simahla)
description: Isikhokelo esipheleleyo sokukhuphela iividiyo ze-TikTok ngaphandle kwe-watermark kwifowuni nakwi-laptop. Simahla, akukho app, akukho kungena.
body:
Ufuna ukugcina ividiyo ye-TikTok oyithandayo kodwa akufuni ilogo negama le-akhawunti kuncamathele kwisikrini? Ungakhuphela iividiyo ze-TikTok ngaphandle kwe-watermark (uphawu lwamanzi) ngendlela elula kakhulu: kopa ilinki yevidiyo, uyincamathisele kwi-I Need Save, uze ukhethe umgangatho owufunayo. Akufuneki ufake i-app eyongezelelweyo, akufuneki ungene, kwaye isimahla.

Kwesi sikhokelo uza kufunda onke amanyathelo, indlela yokukhetha ukhetho olufanelekileyo, kunye nesisombululo ukuba ividiyo ayikaveli kwi-gallery.

Kutheni Ukhetha Iividiyo ze-TikTok Ngaphandle kwe-Watermark?

Xa ugcina ividiyo ngeqhosha le-TikTok ngokwayo, iziphumo zidla ngokuba ne-watermark eyilogo negama lomsebenzisi. Ukuze uyibukele wena isenokungabi yingxaki, kodwa i-watermark inokugquma iindawo ezibalulekileyo zevidiyo, umzekelo umbhalo weresiphi, amanyathelo esifundo, okanye amazwi engoma.

Inguqulelo engenayo i-watermark ibonakala icocekile kwaye imnandi ukuyibukela kaninzi. Yiyo loo nto i-I Need Save ikhetha kuqala inguqulelo engenayo i-watermark xa ifumaneka kwividiyo oyincamathiselayo.

Indlela Yokukhuphela Iividiyo ze-TikTok Ngaphandle kwe-Watermark kwiFowuni

Ungenza la manyathelo kwi-Android okanye kwi-iPhone. Qinisekisa ukuba ividiyo ivela kwi-akhawunti evulelekileyo.

  1. Vula i-app ye-TikTok uze ukhangele ividiyo ofuna ukuyigcina.
  2. Cofa iqhosha elithi Yabelana (Share) kuloo vidiyo.
  3. Khetha Kopa ilinki (Copy link). Ilinki yevidiyo ngoku ikwibhodi yokukopa.
  4. Vula i-browser, uze undwendwele i-ineedsave.com.
  5. Ncamathisela ilinki kwibhokisi ekhoyo, okanye ucofe nje iqhosha elithi Ncamathisela.
  6. Cofa Khuphela uze ulinde kancinci de kuvele ukhetho lweefayile.
  7. Khetha ukhetho lwevidiyo olufunayo. Ifayile iya kukhutshelwa ngqo kwisixhobo sakho.

Ukuba iqhosha litshintsha okwethutyana libe ngu-Iyalungiselela…, sukoyika. Ezinye iividiyo zifuna ukusetyenzwa kuqala, umzekelo ividiyo nesandi sayo ziyadityaniswa. Ukukhuphela kuya kuqala ngokuzenzekelayo xa ifayile ilungile.

Indlela Yokukhuphela kwi-Laptop okanye kwiKhompyutha

Indlela iphantse ifane. Vula i-TikTok kwi-browser yekhompyutha, khetha ividiyo oyifunayo, uze ukope ilinki yayo kwimenyu ethi Yabelana okanye kwi-address bar. Emva koko vula iphepha lokukhuphela, ncamathisela ilinki, cofa Khuphela, uze ukhethe umgangatho. Ifayile iya kungena kwifolda ethi Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo) kwikhompyutha yakho.

Ukuqonda Ukhetho Oluvelayo

Emva kokucofa Khuphela, uya kubona ukhetho oluninzi. Nantsi inkcazelo emfutshane:

  • Ividiyo kwimigangatho eyahlukeneyo, umzekelo 360p, 720p, okanye 1080p, kuxhomekeke kwividiyo yokuqala. Xa inani liphezulu, umfanekiso ucaca ngakumbi, kodwa nefayile iba nkulu.
  • Uphawu lwamanzi: ukhetho olusenayo i-watermark lubhalwe eli gama. Ukuba ufuna ividiyo ecocekileyo, khetha ukhetho lwevidiyo olungabhalwanga ukuthi Uphawu lwamanzi.
  • Isandi: ungathatha ilizwi lodwa, nokuba ngumgangatho wokuqala okanye i-MP3 ye-192 kbps eguqulwe kwividiyo.
  • Ifoto / Umfanekiso omncinci: umfanekiso wesiciko wevidiyo leyo.

Udidekile ngokukhetha i-resolution? Funda nenqaku elithi umahluko phakathi komgangatho wevidiyo we-360p, 720p ne-1080p ukuze ukhethe ngokwesikrini sakho nendawo yokugcina eseleyo kwifowuni.

Icebiso: Ezinye iividiyo ze-TikTok zisebenzisa i-codec ye-HEVC (H.265). Iifowuni ezindala kakhulu ngamanye amaxesha azikwazi ukuzidlala kakuhle. Ukuba lukhona ukhetho lwe-H.264, lukhethe kuba ludlala kuzo zonke izixhobo.

Iphi Ividiyo Ekhutshelweyo?

Indawo yefayile ixhomekeke kwisixhobo osisebenzisayo:

  • I-Android: ividiyo igcinwa kwifolda ethi Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo). I-app ye-Gallery ngamanye amaxesha ifuna ixesha elincinci phambi kokuba iyibonise.
  • I-iPhone/iPad (Safari): ividiyo ingena kwi-app ethi Files, kwifolda ethi Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo). Ukuze ivele kwi-app ethi Photos, vula ividiyo kwi-Files, cofa Share (Yabelana), uze ukhethe Save Video (Gcina Ividiyo).

Iifayile ze-MP4 ezikhutshelweyo zinobude bexesha obuchanekileyo kwaye zidlala kwii-app ze-gallery njengeevidiyo eziqhelekileyo. Kufuneka wazi nokuba iifayile zidluliselwa ngqo zisuka kwi-TikTok ziye kwisixhobo sakho kwaye azigcinwa kwiseva ye-I Need Save.

Kutheni Ividiyo Ingaphumeleli Ukukhutshelwa?

Kukho iimeko ezimbalwa ezenza ividiyo ingakwazi ukuthathwa:

  • Ividiyo ivela kwi-akhawunti yabucala.
  • Umxholo ubonakala kuphela emva kokungena.
  • Ividiyo ithintelwe kwimimandla ethile.
  • Ilinki encanyathiselweyo ayiphelelanga okanye ikopwe kakubi.

Kwimeko yokugqibela, zama ukukopa kwakhona ilinki ngqo kwiqhosha elithi Yabelana, uze uphinde inkqubo ukusuka ekuqaleni.

Yisebenzise Ngobulumko

Khuphela iividiyo kuphela ukuze uzisebenzisele wena. Hlonipha ilungelo lokushicilela labadali: qala ucele imvume phambi kokupapasha kwakhona uze uhlale ukhankanya umnini wokuqala. Ngale ndlela, usenokuwonwabela umxholo owuthandayo ngaphandle kokwenzakalisa abawenzileyo.

Imibuzo Ebuzwa Rhoqo

Ngaba i-I Need Save isimahla?

Ewe, isimahla. Akufuneki kwakhona ufake i-app okanye uvule i-akhawunti. Vula nje isayithi kwi-browser.

Ngaba zonke iividiyo ze-TikTok ziyafumaneka ngaphandle kwe-watermark?

Inguqulelo engenayo i-watermark isoloko ikhethwa kuqala xa ifumaneka. Ukuba kwividiyo ethile kuvela kuphela ukhetho olubhalwe ukuthi Uphawu lwamanzi, usenokuyikhuphela loo nguqulelo.

Ndingathatha ilizwi lodwa?

Ewe. Khetha ukhetho oluthi Isandi, nokuba ngumgangatho wokuqala okanye i-MP3 ye-192 kbps. Akudingi app yokuguqula eyahlukileyo. Isikhokelo esipheleleyo sikwinqaku elithi indlela yokuguqula ividiyo ibe yi-MP3.
